YES BANK AT-1 BONDHOLDERS URGE RBI TO PROTECT INVESTORS

On 19 November 2026, holders of Yes Bank’s AT‑1 bonds sent a letter to the RBI urging it to prioritise investor protection after the central bank sought a review of a Supreme Court ruling that had restored those bonds.

The move signals bond investors’ concern over regulatory actions and could influence confidence in the banking sector’s debt instruments.

For information only. Not investment advice.
